impact: The product-status table says WordPress is planned and not yet implemented, but WP-CLI, hardening, cron switching, runtime detection and a workspace UI all ship today. The stale status misleads anyone scoping the work.
resolution: Fixed in T-018: README now describes what ships (WordPress managed on BYO servers) and points at docs/adr/managed-wordpress-surface.md for the dply-hosted surface, which is scoped but not built.
title: README states WordPress is unimplemented while substantial VM support exists
